title: The Call of The Void
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
Listen and embrace the unstoppable, all-encompassing darkness of deep trance. Heed my call and allow yourself to be taken by the void, where thoughts can’t exist. Where awareness and consciousness fear to trek.
Abandon all resistance and dislodge your mind. Listen and forget. Listen and give in.
The sessions itself doesn’t have instructions for participation during the file, but there are plenty of post-hypnotic suggestions.No induction. No wakener. Only trance.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
